description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN DOWNTOWN 1 Downtown One is a construction of 40 floors above ground and 5 floors of underground parking, multifunctional, positioned in the heart of Tirana. The project comes from the world-famous architectural studio MVRDV of the well-known Dutch architect Winy Maas. The building has a dedicated reception for the residential premises: 4 elevators dedicated to the residents Waste dischargers on each floor Apartment height: 3.3m Security and maintenance 24H Information on the Apartment: -New construction -Gross area 138.25m2 -Net area 108.6m2 -Floor 25 -North-West-East Organization: -Salon living room -kitchen area -1 bedroom -1 toilet -storage room
